verses.original: הֲלֹֽא־ חָכְמָ֥ה תִקְרָ֑א וּ֝תְבוּנָ֗ה תִּתֵּ֥ן קוֹלָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō- ḥāḵ·māh ṯiq·rā ū·ṯə·ḇū·nāh tit·tên qō·w·lāh
verses.literal: Does not wisdom call out and understanding raise her voice

verses.original: בְּרֹאשׁ־ מְרוֹמִ֥ים עֲלֵי־ דָ֑רֶךְ בֵּ֖ית נְתִיב֣וֹת נִצָּֽבָה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·rōš- mə·rō·w·mîm ‘ă·lê- ḏā·reḵ bêṯ nə·ṯî·ḇō·wṯ niṣ·ṣā·ḇāh
verses.literal: On the heights . . . overlooking the road at the crossroads . . . she takes her stand

verses.original: לְיַד־ שְׁעָרִ֥ים לְפִי־ קָ֑רֶת מְב֖וֹא פְתָחִ֣ים תָּרֹֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: lə·yaḏ- šə·‘ā·rîm lə·p̄î- qā·reṯ mə·ḇō·w p̄ə·ṯā·ḥîm tā·rōn·nāh
verses.literal: Beside the gates to the city at the entrances . . . she cries out

verses.original: אֲלֵיכֶ֣ם אִישִׁ֣ים אֶקְרָ֑א וְ֝קוֹלִ֗י אֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·lê·ḵem ’î·šîm ’eq·rā wə·qō·w·lî ’el- bə·nê ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: To you O men I call out and my cry is to the sons of men

verses.original: פְתָאיִ֣ם הָבִ֣ינוּ עָרְמָ֑ה וּ֝כְסִילִ֗ים הָבִ֥ינוּ לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: p̄ə·ṯā·yim hā·ḇî·nū ‘ā·rə·māh ū·ḵə·sî·lîm hā·ḇî·nū lêḇ
verses.literal: O simple ones learn to be shrewd O fools gain understanding . . .

verses.original: שִׁ֭מְעוּ כִּֽי־ אֲדַבֵּ֑ר נְגִידִ֣ים וּמִפְתַּ֥ח שְׂ֝פָתַ֗י מֵישָׁרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: Šim·ʿû kî- ’ă·ḏab·bêr nə·ḡî·ḏîm ū·mip̄·taḥ śə·p̲ā·t̲ai mê·šā·rîm
verses.literal: Listen for I speak of noble things and the opening of my lips [will reveal] right

verses.original: כִּֽי־ חִכִּ֑י יֶהְגֶּ֣ה אֱ֭מֶת רֶֽשַׁע׃ וְתוֹעֲבַ֖ת שְׂפָתַ֣י
verses.transliteration: kî- ḥik·kî yeh·geh ’ĕ·meṯ re·ša‘ wə·ṯō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ śə·p̄ā·ṯay
verses.literal: For my mouth will speak the truth and wickedness is detestable to my lips

verses.original: כָּל־ אִמְרֵי־ פִ֑י בְּצֶ֥דֶק אֵ֥ין בָּ֝הֶ֗ם נִפְתָּ֥ל וְעִקֵּֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’im·rê- p̄î bə·ṣe·ḏeq ’ên bā·hem nip̄·tāl wə·‘iq·qêš
verses.literal: All the words of my mouth are righteous none are crooked or perverse

verses.original: כֻּלָּ֣ם נְ֭כֹחִים לַמֵּבִ֑ין וִֽ֝ישָׁרִ֗ים לְמֹ֣צְאֵי דָֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: kul·lām nə·ḵō·ḥîm lam·mê·ḇîn wî·šā·rîm lə·mō·ṣə·’ê ḏā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: They [are] all plain to the discerning and upright to those who find knowledge

verses.original: קְחֽוּ־ מוּסָרִ֥י וְאַל־ כָּ֑סֶף וְ֝דַ֗עַת נִבְחָֽר׃ מֵחָר֥וּץ
verses.transliteration: qə·ḥū- mū·sā·rî wə·’al- kā·sep̄ wə·ḏa·‘aṯ niḇ·ḥār mê·ḥā·rūṣ
verses.literal: Receive my instruction instead of silver and knowledge rather than pure gold

verses.original: כִּֽי־ חָ֭כְמָה טוֹבָ֣ה מִפְּנִינִ֑ים וְכָל־ לֹ֣א חֲ֝פָצִ֗ים יִֽשְׁווּ־ בָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ḥāḵ·māh ṭō·w·ḇāh mip·pə·nî·nîm wə·ḵāl lō ḥă·p̄ā·ṣîm yiš·wū- ḇāh
verses.literal: For wisdom is more precious than rubies and nothing . . . you desire compares with her

verses.original: אֲ‍ֽנִי־ חָ֭כְמָה שָׁכַ֣נְתִּי עָרְמָ֑ה אֶמְצָֽא׃ וְדַ֖עַת מְזִמּ֣וֹת
verses.transliteration: ’ănî- ḥāḵ·māh šā·ḵan·tî ‘ā·rə·māh ’em·ṣā wə·ḏa·‘aṯ mə·zim·mō·wṯ
verses.literal: I wisdom dwell together with prudence and I find knowledge and discretion

verses.original: יִֽרְאַ֣ת יְהוָה֮ שְֽׂנֹ֫את רָ֥ע שָׂנֵֽאתִי׃ וְגָא֨וֹן׀ גֵּ֘אָ֤ה רָ֭ע וְדֶ֣רֶךְ תַהְפֻּכ֬וֹת וּפִ֨י
verses.transliteration: yir·’aṯ Yah·weh śə·nōṯ rā‘ śā·nê·ṯî wə·ḡā·’ō·wn gê·’āh rā‘ wə·ḏe·reḵ ṯah·pu·ḵō·wṯ ū·p̄î
verses.literal: To fear the LORD is to hate evil I hate arrogant pride evil conduct and perverse speech

verses.original: עֵ֭צָה וְתוּשִׁיָּ֑ה לִֽי־ אֲנִ֥י בִ֝ינָ֗ה לִ֣י גְבוּרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·ṣāh wə·ṯū·šî·yāh lî- ’ă·nî ḇî·nāh lî ḡə·ḇū·rāh
verses.literal: Counsel and sound judgment are mine I have insight and strength

verses.original: בִּ֭י מְלָכִ֣ים יִמְלֹ֑כוּ וְ֝רוֹזְנִ֗ים צֶֽדֶק׃ יְחֹ֣קְקוּ
verses.transliteration: bî mə·lā·ḵîm yim·lō·ḵū wə·rō·wz·nîm ṣe·ḏeq yə·ḥō·qə·qū
verses.literal: By me kings reign and rulers enact just laws

verses.original: בִּ֭י שָׂרִ֣ים יָשֹׂ֑רוּ כָּל־ וּ֝נְדִיבִ֗ים שֹׁ֥פְטֵי צֶֽדֶק׃
verses.transliteration: bî śā·rîm yā·śō·rū kāl- ū·nə·ḏî·ḇîm šō·p̄ə·ṭê ṣe·ḏeq
verses.literal: By me princes rule and all nobles who govern justly

verses.original: אֲ֭נִי אֹהֲבֶיהָ אֵהָ֑ב וּ֝מְשַׁחֲרַ֗י יִמְצָאֻֽנְנִי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî ʾō·hă·ḇɛ·hå̄ ’ê·hāḇ ū·mə·ša·ḥă·ray yim·ṣā·’un·nî
verses.literal: I love those who love me and those who seek me early shall find me

verses.original: אִתִּ֑י עֹֽשֶׁר־ וְכָב֥וֹד עָ֝תֵ֗ק ה֥וֹן וּצְדָקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’it·tî ‘ō·šer- wə·ḵā·ḇō·wḏ ‘ā·ṯêq hō·wn ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh
verses.literal: With me are riches and honor enduring wealth and righteousness

verses.original: פִּ֭רְיִי ט֣וֹב מֵחָר֣וּץ וּמִפָּ֑ז וּ֝תְבוּאָתִ֗י נִבְחָֽר׃ מִכֶּ֥סֶף
verses.transliteration: pir·yî ṭō·wḇ mê·ḥā·rūṣ ū·mip·pāz ū·ṯə·ḇū·’ā·ṯî niḇ·ḥār mik·ke·sep̄
verses.literal: My fruit is better than gold pure gold and my harvest [surpasses] choice silver

verses.original: אֲהַלֵּ֑ך בְּאֹֽרַח־ צְדָקָ֥ה בְּ֝ת֗וֹךְ נְתִיב֥וֹת מִשְׁפָּֽט׃
verses.transliteration: ʾă·hal·lēḵ bə·’ō·raḥ- ṣə·ḏā·qāh bə·ṯō·wḵ nə·ṯî·ḇō·wṯ miš·pāṭ
verses.literal: I walk in the way of righteousness along the paths of justice

verses.original: לְהַנְחִ֖יל יֵ֑שׁ אֹהֲבַ֥י׀ אֲמַלֵּֽא׃פ וְאֹצְרֹ֖תֵיהֶ֣ם
verses.transliteration: lə·han·ḥîl yêš ’ō·hă·ḇay ’ă·mal·lê wə·’ō·ṣə·rō·ṯê·hem
verses.literal: bestowing wealth on those who love me and making their treasuries {full}

verses.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה קָ֭נָנִי רֵאשִׁ֣ית דַּרְכּ֑וֹ קֶ֖דֶם מִפְעָלָ֣יו מֵאָֽז׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh qā·nā·nî rê·šîṯ dar·kōw qe·ḏem mip̄·‘ā·lāw mê·’āz
verses.literal: The LORD created me as His first course before His works of old

verses.original: מֵ֭עוֹלָם נִסַּ֥כְתִּי מֵרֹ֗אשׁ אָֽרֶץ׃ מִקַּדְמֵי־
verses.transliteration: mê·‘ō·w·lām nis·saḵ·tî mê·rōš ’ā·reṣ miq·qaḏ·mê-
verses.literal: From everlasting I was established from the beginning before the earth began

verses.original: בְּאֵין־ תְּהֹמ֥וֹת חוֹלָ֑לְתִּי בְּאֵ֥ין מַ֝עְיָנ֗וֹת נִכְבַּדֵּי־ מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·’ên- tə·hō·mō·wṯ ḥō·w·lā·lə·tî bə·’ên ma‘·yā·nō·wṯ niḵ·bad·dê- mā·yim
verses.literal: When there were no watery depths I was brought forth when no springs were overflowing with water

verses.original: בְּטֶ֣רֶם הָרִ֣ים הָטְבָּ֑עוּ לִפְנֵ֖י גְבָע֣וֹת חוֹלָֽלְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ṭe·rem hā·rîm hā·ṭə·bā·‘ū lip̄·nê ḡə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ ḥō·w·lā·lə·tî
verses.literal: Before the mountains were settled before the hills I was brought forth

verses.original: עַד־ לֹ֣א עָ֭שָׂה אֶ֣רֶץ וְחוּצ֑וֹת וְ֝רֹ֗אשׁ עָפְר֥וֹת תֵּבֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ‘aḏ- lō ‘ā·śāh ’e·reṣ wə·ḥū·ṣō·wṯ wə·rōš ʿå̄·p̄ə·rōṯ tê·ḇêl
verses.literal: before . . . He made the land or fields or any of the dust of the earth

verses.original: אָ֑נִי שָׁ֣ם בַּהֲכִינ֣וֹ שָׁ֭מַיִם בְּח֥וּקוֹ ח֝֗וּג עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י תְהֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·nî šām ba·hă·ḵî·nōw šā·ma·yim bə·ḥū·qōw ḥūḡ ‘al- pə·nê ṯə·hō·wm
verses.literal: I was there when He established the heavens when He inscribed a circle on the face of the deep

verses.original: בְּאַמְּצ֣וֹ שְׁחָקִ֣ים מִמָּ֑עַל עִינ֥וֹת תְּהוֹם׃ בַּ֝עֲז֗וֹז
verses.transliteration: bə·’am·mə·ṣōw šə·ḥā·qîm mim·mā·‘al ‘î·nō·wṯ tə·hōm ba·‘ă·zō·wz
verses.literal: when He established the clouds above when the fountains of the deep gushed forth

verses.original: בְּשׂ֘וּמ֤וֹ חֻקּ֗וֹ לַיָּ֨ם׀ וּ֭מַיִם לֹ֣א יַֽעַבְרוּ־ פִ֑יו בְּ֝חוּק֗וֹ מ֣וֹסְדֵי אָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·śū·mōw ḥuq·qōw lay·yām ū·ma·yim lō ya·‘aḇ·rū- p̄îw bə·ḥū·qōw mō·ws·ḏê ’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: when He set a boundary for the sea so that the waters would not surpass His command when He marked out the foundations of the earth

verses.original: וָֽאֶהְיֶ֥ה אָ֫מ֥וֹן אֶצְל֗וֹ וָֽאֶהְיֶ֣ה שַׁ֭עֲשֻׁעִים י֤וֹם׀ י֑וֹם מְשַׂחֶ֖קֶת בְּכָל־ עֵֽת׃ לְפָנָ֣יו
verses.transliteration: wā·’eh·yeh ’ā·mō·wn ’eṣ·lōw wā·’eh·yeh ‘ă·šu·‘îm yō·wm yō·wm mə·śa·ḥe·qeṯ bə·ḵāl ‘êṯ lə·p̄ā·nāw
verses.literal: Then I was a skilled craftsman at His side and His delight day [by] day rejoicing always . . . in His presence

verses.original: מְ֭שַׂחֶקֶת בְּתֵבֵ֣ל אַרְצ֑וֹ וְ֝שַׁעֲשֻׁעַ֗י אֶת־ בְּנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: mə·śa·ḥe·qeṯ bə·ṯê·ḇêl ’ar·ṣōw wə·ša·‘ă·šu·‘ay ’eṯ- bə·nê ’ā·ḏām
verses.literal: I was rejoicing in His whole world . . . delighting together in the sons of men

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֣ה בָ֭נִים שִׁמְעוּ־ לִ֑י וְ֝אַשְׁרֵ֗י יִשְׁמֹֽרוּ׃ דְּרָכַ֥י
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ḇā·nîm šim·‘ū- lî wə·’aš·rê yiš·mō·rū də·rā·ḵay
verses.literal: Now therefore my sons listen to me for blessed are those who keep my ways

verses.original: שִׁמְע֖וּ מוּסָ֥ר וַחֲכָ֗מוּ וְאַל־ תִּפְרָֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū mū·sār wa·ḥă·ḵā·mū wə·’al- tip̄·rā·‘ū
verses.literal: Listen to instruction and be wise do not ignore it

verses.original: אַ֥שְֽׁרֵי אָדָם֮ שֹׁמֵ֪עַֽ֫ לִ֥י לִשְׁקֹ֣ד י֤וֹם׀ י֑וֹם עַל־ דַּ֭לְתֹתַי לִ֝שְׁמֹ֗ר מְזוּזֹ֥ת פְּתָחָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’aš·rê ’ā·ḏām šō·mê·a‘ lî liš·qōḏ yō·wm yō·wm ‘al- dal·ṯō·ṯay liš·mōr mə·zū·zōṯ pə·ṯā·ḥāy
verses.literal: Blessed is the man who listens to me watching daily . . . at my doors waiting at the posts of my doorway

verses.original: כִּ֣י מֹ֭צְאִי מֹצְאֵי חַיִּ֑ים וַיָּ֥פֶק רָ֝צ֗וֹן מֵיְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî mō·ṣə·’î mō·ṣə·ʾē ḥay·yîm way·yā·p̄eq rā·ṣō·wn Yah·weh
verses.literal: For whoever finds me finds life and obtains the favor of the LORD

verses.original: וְֽ֭חֹטְאִי חֹמֵ֣ס נַפְשׁ֑וֹ כָּל־ מְ֝שַׂנְאַ֗י אָ֣הֲבוּ מָֽוֶת׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥō·ṭə·’î ḥō·mês nap̄·šōw kāl- mə·śan·’ay ’ā·hă·ḇū mā·weṯ
verses.literal: But he who fails to find me harms himself all who hate me love death
